why: rc12: spell and talent description markers, translated emote tags

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc12 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: spell names inside spell and talent descriptions are marked as spells (coloured, follow the spell switch). Hunter's Mark now reads as a spell in its own description; 42 plain spell names were marked and 16 spell names written as terms or NPCs were moved to the spell family.
Fix: the emote tags in quest texts (snort, cough ...) are Persian now.

Includes rc11 (NPC names, full map zone names, share codes, marked quest names) and rc7 to rc10.

Data from ForeverDB.net
